name: Vindornyalak (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vindornyalak: a blue and green shield with a white manor house, above a scroll inscribed VINDORNYALAK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
